title: Corporate Spending on AI Stalls Despite Rising Usage, Ramp Data Shows
summary: Data from corporate spend management platform Ramp shows corporate expenditure on AI tools has leveled off even as active software usage continues to grow. Price reductions and cost controls among major enterprise users are moderating revenue expansion across AI vendors.
point1: Ramp transaction data indicates enterprise AI spending has plateaued despite increasing user activity.
point2: Corporate clients are increasingly adopting tighter budget controls and lower-cost model tiers.

title: Meta Warns Local Political Opposition to Data Centers Threatens AI Expansion
summary: Meta warned that growing political opposition to data centers could restrict future artificial intelligence infrastructure. The warning follows U.S. midterm elections where voters approved restrictions on data center developments in 40 of 41 ballot measures.
point1: Meta cautioned that public opposition to data centers threatens planned AI capacity expansions.
point2: Voters across multiple jurisdictions passed local ballot measures restricting data center construction due to power and resource concerns.

title: Somali Supreme Court Strikes Down Presidential Term Extension
summary: Somalia's Supreme Court has rejected a proposed extension of the president's term in office. The judicial decision adds uncertainty to planned nationwide elections set for next year.
point1: Somalia's highest court ruled against extending the president's official tenure.
point2: The ruling invalidates term extension efforts amid opposition challenges ahead of direct national elections.
point3: Somalia's nationwide elections remain scheduled for 2027.

title: Pope Leo Embarks on Latin America Visit Following Lung Surgery
summary: Pope Leo has begun an extended trip to Latin America, with scheduled stops in Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru. The international journey comes weeks after the pontiff underwent surgery to remove part of a lung.
point1: Pope Leo departed on a multi-country Latin American tour of Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru.
point2: The trip marks his first major international travel following lung cancer surgery last month.
point3: The pastoral visit will proceed across the three nations over the coming days.

title: European Airlines Hit by Wave of Hoax Bomb Threats
summary: Numerous commercial flights across Europe were impacted by a series of bomb threats made against airlines. Security authorities confirmed that no explosives were found on any searched planes.
point1: Scores of flights across multiple European airlines received targeted bomb threats.
point2: Inspections revealed no active explosives aboard affected aircraft.
point3: Security investigations into the origin of the threats are ongoing.

title: Kenyan Doomsday Cult Leader Paul Mackenzie Sentenced to Life Imprisonment
summary: Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie has been sentenced to life in prison for the murder of 191 people. Mackenzie directed his followers to starve themselves and their children to death in a forest to fulfill a religious command.
point1: Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to life imprisonment following his conviction for 191 murders.
point2: The ruling concludes legal proceedings surrounding one of the mass starvation cases in recent history.

title: CBI Registers ₹904 Crore Bank Fraud Case Against Future Retail and Kishore Biyani
summary: India's Central Bureau of Investigation has booked Future Retail and founder Kishore Biyani over an alleged ₹904 crore bank fraud. The action follows a complaint by State Bank of India alleging improper utilization of loan facilities.
point1: The CBI booked Future Retail and founder Kishore Biyani in a ₹904 crore fraud case.
point2: State Bank of India alleged that credit facilities were diverted contrary to approved bank terms.
point3: CBI searches and legal proceedings remain ongoing in Mumbai.

title: ADNOC Signs 10-Year LNG Supply Deal with Gujarat Energy
summary: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company has signed a 10-year liquefied natural gas supply agreement with Gujarat Energy. The deal marks ADNOC's fifth long-term LNG contract with an Indian entity.
point1: ADNOC finalized a 10-year LNG supply and purchase deal with Gujarat Energy.
point2: The agreement secures long-term natural gas supplies to meet energy demands in Western India.
point3: Deliveries will proceed under the contracted 10-year timeline.

title: Fox Completes $22 Billion Acquisition of Roku
summary: Fox has officially completed its $22 billion acquisition of streaming giant Roku. The deal closed several months after Department of Justice investigators reviewed the merger.
point1: Fox finalized its acquisition of Roku in a deal valued at $22 billion.
point2: The merger represents a major consolidation of traditional media and digital streaming hardware and platforms.

title: India's IT Ministry Approves 12 New Projects Under Electronics Component Scheme
summary: India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology approved 12 additional manufacturing projects under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme. The program provides turnover-linked financial incentives to build up domestic component production.
point1: The IT Ministry sanctioned 12 projects under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme.
point2: The scheme grants turnover-based financial support across local electronics manufacturing units.

title: NPCI Establishes Technology Subsidiary for AI and Digital Financial Infrastructure
summary: The National Payments Corporation of India has created a new technology subsidiary, NPCI Tech Solutions, to focus on artificial intelligence, blockchain, and financial technology infrastructure. Vishal Kanvaty has been appointed Managing Director and CEO of the new unit.
point1: NPCI incorporated a dedicated technological entity named NPCI Tech Solutions.
point2: The company will focus on artificial intelligence, blockchain initiatives, and digital payment frameworks.

title: Indian Stock Market Surges as Sensex Jumps 1,718 Points and Nifty Reclaims 25,000
summary: Indian benchmark equity indices surged sharply, with the BSE Sensex rising 1,718 points and the NSE Nifty crossing the 25,000 mark. The rally extends a seven-session winning streak that has seen the Sensex gain over 10%.
point1: The BSE Sensex surged 1,718 points, while the Nifty 50 closed above 25,000.
point2: The index has gained over 10% across seven consecutive trading sessions due to foreign fund inflows.

title: Tesla to End Cybertruck Production in 2027 to Focus on Cybercabs
summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced that the electric vehicle manufacturer will cease production of the Cybertruck in 2027. Factory space currently used for the vehicle will be reallocated to increase production of Tesla's autonomous Cybercab fleet.
point1: Tesla will officially halt Cybertruck production in 2027.
point2: Manufacturing capacity will be shifted to scale up output of autonomous Cybercabs.
point3: Production of the Cybertruck is scheduled to end in 2027.

title: The New York Times In Talks to Purchase Letterboxd for $330 Million
summary: The New York Times Company is reportedly in negotiations to acquire film social platform Letterboxd in a deal valued at $330 million. Letterboxd has seen significant audience growth in recent years.
point1: The NYT is reportedly discussing a $330 million acquisition of film social network Letterboxd.
point2: The deal represents potential major expansion for the media company's digital portfolio.

title: Wave of Hoax Bomb Threats Disrupts European Aviation Infrastructure
summary: European airports and airlines faced widespread operational disruption following a second series of coordinated hoax bomb threats in a single week. At least 21 flights across the continent were affected by the malicious threats.
point1: At least 21 commercial flights across Europe were impacted by fake security threats.
point2: The incidents mark the second wave of coordinated aviation disruptions in Europe within a week.
point3: Government security investigations into the origin of the hoaxes are ongoing.

title: Dropbox Acquires Tigris Data for $350 Million for AI Storage Platform
summary: Dropbox announced a $350 million deal to acquire Tigris Data to strengthen its artificial intelligence infrastructure. The transaction will support the rollout of DBX Agent Cloud, a platform tailored for building and hosting AI models.
point1: Dropbox agreed to acquire Tigris Data in a $350 million transaction.
point2: The acquisition powers Dropbox's DBX Agent Cloud infrastructure for AI developers.

title: Meta, Google, and TikTok Sue California Over Youth Social Media Law
summary: Meta, Google, and TikTok have filed a joint lawsuit against the California Attorney General over new state legislation. The law would restrict social media access for minors under the age of 16.
point1: Major tech companies filed suit to block California's teen social media restrictions.
point2: The law aims to restrict social media platform access for users under 16.
point3: The contested law is scheduled to take effect next year.

title: Democratic Socialist Candidate Defeats Incumbent Karen Bass in Los Angeles Mayoral Race
summary: Incumbent Mayor Karen Bass was defeated by a democratic socialist challenger in the Los Angeles mayoral election. Following recent municipal elections, America's two largest cities—New York and Los Angeles—are both set to be led by democratic socialists.
point1: Karen Bass lost her re-election bid to a democratic socialist candidate.
point2: The election puts both New York City and Los Angeles under democratic socialist mayoral leadership.

title: California Governor Commutes Death Sentences for 548 Inmates
summary: The Governor of California has commuted the sentences of all 548 inmates on the state's death row. California historically held the largest population of death row prisoners in the United States.
point1: Sentences for 548 death row inmates were officially commuted.
point2: The move reshapes the legal standing of the largest state death row population in the US.

title: US Government Issues Warning Over Mass Cyberattacks Targetting Refrigeration Systems
summary: The U.S. government issued a joint statement warning of an ongoing cyber threat following widespread attacks on industrial retail and military freezers. The intrusions affect essential cold storage infrastructure across the food, transportation, and healthcare industries.
point1: Mass hacks have compromised commercial and military refrigeration units globally.
point2: The cyberattacks impact cold-chain logistics across food, healthcare, and transport sectors.
point3: U.S. officials warned the cyber threat remains active and ongoing.

title: India opens ninth auction round for 20 critical mineral blocks
summary: India's Ministry of Mines launched the ninth tranche of mineral auctions, offering 20 new critical mineral blocks. Across eight previous tranches, 64 out of 100 offered strategic mineral blocks were successfully auctioned.
point1: The Ministry of Mines put 20 new critical and strategic mineral blocks up for auction.
point2: India has successfully auctioned 64 out of 100 strategic mineral blocks offered to date.

title: NPCI tells Supreme Court zero MDR on UPI is no longer sustainable
summary: The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) informed the Supreme Court that imposing Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) charges is required to preserve the UPI ecosystem. NPCI stated that zero MDR can no longer sustain the network's infrastructural and security demands.
point1: NPCI submitted to the Supreme Court that zero MDR is unsustainable given transaction scale.
point2: MDR revenue is cited as necessary to fund system security, operational resilience, and growth.

title: Bharti Airtel Q2 net profit jumps 24% to ₹10,710 crore
summary: Bharti Airtel reported a 24% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to ₹10,710 crore for the quarter ending September. Revenue from the company's India operations grew 9.4% to ₹42,308 crore.
point1: Bharti Airtel recorded a quarterly net profit of ₹10,710 crore.
point2: India region operations generated ₹42,308 crore in revenue during the quarter.

title: TikTok launches standalone TikTok Shop application
summary: TikTok has released a separate standalone mobile app dedicated entirely to TikTok Shop. The platform features curated recommendations, livestream shopping integration, in-app checkout, and order tracking.
point1: TikTok introduced a dedicated standalone application for its e-commerce product, TikTok Shop.
point2: The software separates e-commerce features into an independent environment.

title: Zipline valuation hits $21.5B following $1.5B capital raise
summary: Drone logistics company Zipline raised $1.5 billion in funding, raising its private valuation to $21.5 billion. The capital injection comes as retail partner Walmart broadens its drone delivery deployment.
point1: Zipline closed $1.5 billion in funding to achieve a $21.5 billion valuation.
point2: Walmart expanded its operational commitment to Zipline's drone delivery infrastructure.

title: Agility Robotics lists on Nasdaq as first public pure-play humanoid robot stock
summary: Agility Robotics has debuted on the Nasdaq exchange, becoming the first publicly traded pure-play humanoid robotics business. The listing represents a key milestone for commercial humanoid robotics development.
point1: Agility Robotics began trading on the Nasdaq public market.
point2: It is the first pure-play manufacturer focused on humanoid robotics to go public.

title: OpenAI President Greg Brockman indicates potential IPO readiness by 2027
summary: OpenAI President Greg Brockman stated that the company could be ready for an initial public offering in 2027. Brockman pointed to growth in enterprise revenue and business stabilization as key factors.
point1: OpenAI President Greg Brockman announced the firm may be ready for an IPO in 2027.
point2: The timeline is driven by accelerating enterprise adoption and revenue growth.

title: French nationwide protests escalate as unions strike over cost of living
summary: Protests and strikes expanded across France as labor unions joined demonstrations against high living costs. The interior ministry estimated 600,000 participants nationwide, while unions reported significantly higher turnouts.
point1: An estimated 600,000 people participated in protests across France according to government figures.
point2: Trade unions joined the strike action to press for policy changes regarding cost-of-living pressures.

title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns following bank collapse
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña has resigned following a bank collapse and political pressure from congress. His decision came after the lower house of congress voted to pursue an impeachment trial against him.
point1: President Santiago Peña resigned after the lower house of congress voted to pursue an impeachment trial.
point2: The resignation was precipitated by a systemic bank collapse in Paraguay.

title: Particle physicists observe subatomic decay events at the zeptometer scale
summary: Researchers studying particle interactions have recorded data from an extremely rare matter-decay event, offering insights into physical phenomena at the zeptometer scale. The measurements allow physicists to investigate physical mechanisms at scales 100 billion times smaller than an atom.
point1: Physicists observed an ultra-rare subatomic decay event revealing dynamics at the zeptometer scale.
point2: The discovery advances experimental testing of particle physics beyond established atomic models.

title: CERT-In calls for mandatory security testing of AI agents to prevent privilege abuse
summary: India's cybersecurity agency CERT-In has issued guidelines requiring organizations to test artificial intelligence agents for unauthorized tool usage and privilege escalation risks. The advisory mandates operational safety checks, multi-agent communication logging, and emergency kill-switch capabilities.
point1: CERT-In directed organizations to conduct security testing on AI agents to prevent unauthorized execution and privilege abuse.
point2: The guidelines establish security protocols for multi-agent systems and demand mandatory action logging and kill switches.

title: JD Vance issues scathing election critique blaming Iran war for Republican midterm defeat
summary: Vice President JD Vance offered a blunt public assessment of recent Republican election losses, attributing the midterm defeat largely to foreign policy fallout from war with Iran. The comments mark a notable policy disagreement between a sitting vice president and presidential administration.
point1: Vice President JD Vance attributed Republican midterm election losses to public dissatisfaction with war in Iran.
point2: The statement represents a rare high-level public breach regarding administration policy following congressional shifts.

title: Joshua Wong, face of Hong Kong's pro-democracy protests, jailed for 10 years
summary: Prominent Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong has been sentenced to 10 years in prison under the city's national security law. Wong, 30, was among hundreds of activists detained under Beijing's national security measures in the territory.
point1: Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years in prison under Hong Kong's national security law.
point2: The ruling marks a major step in China's ongoing national security crackdown on Hong Kong's pro-democracy movement.

title: Waymo Confirms Restructuring of Uber Partnership for January 2028
summary: Autonomous vehicle provider Waymo confirmed it will alter its distribution arrangement with Uber starting in January 2028. The shift is set to establish direct commercial competition between the two companies in key operating markets.
point1: Waymo will end aspects of its exclusive ride-hailing arrangement with Uber in early 2028.
point2: The move will pitch Waymo's standalone ride-hailing application directly against Uber's platform.
point3: The revised commercial structure takes effect in January 2028.

title: Apple Reportedly Trims Budget for Internal AI Tool Usage
summary: Apple is reportedly reducing internal budget allocations dedicated to artificial intelligence tools used by its engineering teams. Reports indicate the company is curbing spending limits to manage expenses tied to internal AI deployments.
point1: Apple is scaling back internal AI budget allocations across engineering departments.
point2: The move highlights growing tech sector scrutiny over high compute and operational costs for enterprise AI.

title: Mahadev App Co-Promoter Ravi Uppal Arrested in UAE for Extradition to India
summary: Authorities in Dubai arrested Ravi Uppal, co-promoter of the illegal Mahadev betting app, following an Interpol Red Notice issued at the request of Indian agencies. Indian officials have initiated legal steps to extradite Uppal back to India.
point1: Ravi Uppal was detained by UAE law enforcement on an Interpol Red Notice.
point2: The arrest represents a major step in India's ongoing probe into money laundering and illegal online betting.
point3: Indian agencies are actively executing formal extradition procedures with UAE authorities.

title: Supreme Court Rules Two-Child Penalties Outdated as India's Fertility Declines
summary: The Supreme Court of India stated that legal penalties restricting benefits or public office eligibility for individuals with more than two children have become outdated. The court noted that demographic changes mean earlier fears of overpopulation are no longer valid.
point1: The Supreme Court declared two-child disqualification provisions outdated due to falling fertility rates.
point2: The ruling has major implications for state-level election rules and local public service laws.

title: Cyberattack Compromises Cold Storage at French National Blood Service
summary: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) reported that hackers compromised cold rooms used to store blood supplies. French authorities are investigating the security incident to assess potential impact on national blood inventories.
point1: Hackers targeted temperature control systems in cold rooms operated by the EFS.
point2: The intrusion highlights growing cybersecurity risks facing vital public health infrastructure.
point3: Investigations into the origin and extent of the breach are underway.

title: Ukraine Reports 40 Killed in Russian Double-Tap Air Strike
summary: Ukrainian officials reported that at least 40 people were killed following a Russian double-tap bombing on a village. Officials released bodycam video documenting the strike as rescue teams searched for 30 people feared trapped.
point1: Ukrainian authorities confirmed at least 40 deaths and estimated up to 30 people remain missing in rubble.
point2: The strike underscores continuing severe civilian casualties and infrastructure destruction in Ukraine.
point3: Rescue efforts and rubble clearing operations remain ongoing.

title: Government Proposes Mandatory Suspension for Substandard Drug Manufacturers
summary: India's Health Ministry proposed rule amendments to immediately suspend manufacturing licences of facilities producing substandard drugs. Under the proposal, suspensions will remain enforced until manufacturers implement approved corrective actions.
point1: Proposed amendments require mandatory suspension of licences upon detection of substandard drug batches.
point2: The regulatory change aims to strengthen pharmaceutical quality control and public health safety.
point3: Suspensions will remain active until required corrective measures are completed by manufacturers.

title: Hackers Breach DreamHost System, Accessing Customer Files and Inboxes
summary: Web hosting service DreamHost revealed that malicious actors exploited a system vulnerability during a months-long cyberattack. The hackers successfully compromised customer email inboxes and stored files.
point1: Attackers exploited a vulnerability to access stored customer files and email inboxes over several months.
point2: DreamHost described the breach as a deliberate attack on its hosting infrastructure.

title: Sequoia Capital Consolidates Bay Area Footprint, Raising $10 Billion
summary: Venture capital giant Sequoia Capital is consolidating into a smaller, Bay Area-focused firm, reversing 20 years of international expansion. The firm is shutting down global offices while launching approximately $10 billion in new investment funds.
point1: Sequoia is winding down international offices to focus operations in the San Francisco Bay Area.
point2: The restructuring marks a major strategic pivot for one of Silicon Valley's largest venture capital firms.
point3: Sequoia announced roughly $10 billion in new investment funds alongside the restructuring.

title: Meta Acquires AI Coding Startup Conductor
summary: Meta has acquired Conductor, an artificial intelligence startup that develops tools for software developers. The company's platform allows engineers to deploy multiple AI agents to work concurrently on programming tasks.
point1: Conductor enables software engineers to deploy teams of AI agents on project workflows simultaneously.
point2: The acquisition reinforces Meta's focus on expanding its automated AI development tools and agent capabilities.
